about_the_game:
Barrel Roll is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder but we replaced the deck with a six slot revolver barrel. 

You’re a bounty hunter on the hunt…
- Take down groups of outlaws to reach their leader.

- Collect bullets with special effects, powerful trinkets and resources

- Customize your barrel to make strong synergies and counter your next target.

They're more but you’re sharper…

Battle against groups of 3 to 5 enemies in turn-based fights. 

Shoot and choose your next bullet to create combos. 

Delay your enemies by destroying their shield and don’t lose a second by reloading.

Use one of your 3 skills to turn to tables in your favor !

Lonesome cowborg on the road…

Choose your next destination carefully to gain options for your next fights !
Some resources you’ll find on the road could be super useful at the saloon.

What is your playstyle ? 

Bullets have 5 archetypes: 

  • Damage (You like big numbers ?)

  • Shield (Nothing can stand in your way ?) 

  • Speed (You're tired of waiting for your turn ?)

  • Focus (You think you're the best duelist ?)

and…

  • Killer (You're thirsty for blood ?)

It’s up to you to write your own legend by building your perfect barrel.

In Barrel Roll you'll find...

  • 64 bullets with powerful effects.

  • 30 trinkets to change the way you play.

  • 3 skills to get out of every situations.

  • 9 bosses to make sure you won't stand a chance to beat...

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 3060
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Barrel Roll is a turn based, roguelike, taking place in a futuristic far west. Gather bullets with special effects, customize your revolver's barrel to create strong synergies and take down as much criminal as you can. Don't forget to reload... If you have to of course !
